description: Major bridge reconstruction including structural reinforcement, deck replacement, and seismic upgrades. Three-phase project with traffic management plan.
25-story Class A office tower with underground parking, ground-floor retail, and LEED Gold certification target. Steel frame construction with curtain wall facade.
New 45,000 SF community center with gymnasium, competition pool, multipurpose rooms, and outdoor amphitheater. Achieved LEED Silver certification.
Three-story medical office building with imaging center, outpatient surgery suite, and pharmacy. Requires specialized HVAC and radiation shielding.
12-story mixed-use development with 200 residential units, 30,000 SF retail, and public waterfront plaza. Includes structured parking for 400 vehicles.
Complete renovation of historic 1950s school building. Seismic upgrade, new mechanical systems, ADA compliance, and technology infrastructure modernization.
New 12-gate terminal concourse with automated people mover connection, expanded security checkpoint, and airline lounge facilities. Phased construction to maintain operations.
Upgrade of existing water treatment facility to increase capacity from 20 MGD to 35 MGD. New membrane filtration system, chemical feed building, and SCADA upgrades.
